catalysts.headline: CoreWeave reported Q3 2026 results described as topping estimates; specific revenue/EPS figures not independently located this session

CoreWeave Q3 2026 results: revenue $3.661B (+168% YoY from $1.365B), beating the ~$3.54-3.55B analyst estimate; GAAP net loss $709M (vs $110M prior-year quarter) on operating income of $207M; revenue backlog ~$132.5B; raised FY2026 revenue guidance to $13.0B-$13.3B (from prior guidance on file); still expects >1.85GW of active power capacity by year-end; total debt reported approaching $47B
catalysts.impact: Shares fell to $47.56 after-hours (-2.4%) despite the beat/guidance raise, as coverage flagged the ~$14.5B quarterly capex against only ~$9B of customer prepayments
